scope: All 185 mapped equipment object-price claims from the 188 enumerated PHB35/36 and UA26 source rows. This baseline compares source-coordinate containment against manually annotated complete named table sections. Region candidates are geometric, not asserted fact bindings. Two package offers and one ambiguous quarrel row remain separate source dispositions. Other source prices remain outside this bounded contract.
assessmentLimitations: Required context rectangles here are the complete reviewed proposal crops, including padding. A noncontainment is a conservative review candidate, not a confirmed semantic defect; another complete crop can have different whitespace margins.
Known narrow-row failures are independently calibrated against minimal table/text extents in research/citation-regression-calibration.json.
Source-row boxes originated as provisional inventory geometry and are not proof of exact printed glyph extents.
